raw_segments.text: A coach may, with good management, last ten or twelve years.
It might be taxed, once for all, before it comes out of the hands of the coachmaker.
But it is certainly more convenient for the buyer to pay four pounds a year for the privilege
of keeping a coach than to pay all at once forty or forty-eight pounds additional price
to the coachmaker, or a sum equivalent to what the tax is likely to cost him during
the time he uses the same coach.
A service of plate in the same manner may last more than a century.
